source: DTMO 2026 BAH locality tables (with- and without-dependents), effective 1 Jan 2026. Mapped by official Military Housing Area, not ZIP of residence. Verify at finance / DTMO BAH calculator.
note: BAH is paid by duty-station MHA. Foreign OCONUS posts (Germany, Italy, Korea, Japan, Puerto Rico) use OHA, not these BAH rows. Alaska and Hawaii use BAH plus OCONUS COLA.
